name: chatgpt-ads-library
description: A searchable library of ads running on ChatGPT, built on Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w frontend
